about: Fidelity of alignment and interpretability techniques across architectures. Each cell carries two numbers, not one: the naive port, and a best-effort adaptation by someone who understands the target. The gap between them separates a technique that is architecture-bound in principle from one that is merely architecture-bound in practice. A single number conflates a real limit with an unsolved engineering problem.

method.two_numbers: naive is the technique applied as written to the new architecture. adapted is the technique after someone reworked it for the target's mechanism. A naive score of zero with a high adapted score means the technique was portable and nobody had ported it yet.
method.capability_matching: Cells are only comparable when the models are matched on held-out benchmark performance, not parameter count. Matching on parameters measures architecture and competence at once. Cells below inherit whatever matching their source paper used; the match column records it.
method.ladder_is_partial_order: Architectures are ordered by which interface each removes, not by a distance scalar. Diffusion language models keep the language interface and break causal ordering; a non-linguistic agent keeps causal ordering and has no language interface. Neither is further than the other. Do not fit a curve to this.
method.degradation_is_not_always_monotone: Some architectures remove affordances and add others. State steering exists on recurrent models and has no transformer analogue, so an adapted score above 1.0 relative to the transformer baseline is possible and has been observed.
method.same_architecture_floor: Read every cross-architecture number against the within-architecture floor in baselines below. A frozen monitor already loses measurable accuracy to a LoRA finetune of the same model. A cross-architecture port that scores closer to native than that floor is evidence of a selection effect, not of portability.

architectures.note: Mamba, Mamba-2, RWKV. Keeps a residual accumulator and adds a compressed state.

architectures.name: Recurrent-depth or continuous-thought model
architectures.note: Coconut, CODI, Huginn, and recurrent-depth production systems. Not downstream of pure_ssm; it removes a different interface.

architectures.note: AlphaZero-family. Keeps an output distribution and a residual accumulator.

Localisation is also non-unique, with two head sets sharing 13 of 254 heads (Jaccard 0.03) producing comparable ablation effects. Specific to Mamba-2's coarse gating over fine computation and absent at Mamba-1's channel granularity, so this is a design-choice boundary inside one family, not a distance effect.

cells.note: Partial recovery, and the only genuine fidelity decay curve in this matrix. It is indexed on latent reasoning depth, not on architectural distance. Misalignment concentrates at reasoning's inception, so a monitor should target the first latent steps.
cells.match: within-model comparison against its own explicit-CoT condition

cells.note: Load-bearing caveat: models were admitted only if they reached above 50% retrieval under ridge mapping to Llama-3.2-3B, and that pass rate is unreported. No shuffled-pair null and no ridge-map baseline are given, so the screen may be doing the alignment work. Scope is explicitly linearly compatible transformers, 1.24B to 14.8B. One onboarded model scored 6% recall on a sentiment axis, below chance.
cells.match: performance range reported, not matched pairwise

cells.note: Same screen caveat as the cell above. Separately, the basis itself is contested: trained SAEs barely beat randomized-direction baselines on interpretability (0.90 vs 0.87), sparse probing (0.72 vs 0.69) and causal editing (0.72 vs 0.73, where random wins), and recover 9% of true features on synthetic data with known ground truth at 71% explained variance. A portability number over an unreliable basis is hard to interpret.

naive.finding: transfers once a reference policy exists; the anchor must be built by imitation because no human prior comes for free

adapted.finding: applying the penalty inside search rather than only to the policy network converges to a KL-regularised equilibrium

cells.note: Demonstrates that the portable tier really is portable. The cost moved from the technique to anchor construction.

within_architecture_monitor_staleness.about: How much a frozen activation monitor loses to an update of the same model. The floor any cross-architecture claim must be read against.
within_architecture_monitor_staleness.implication: A LoRA finetune of the same model costs about 0.037 AUC. A cross-architecture port scoring within 0.004 of native is therefore better than staying on the same model through a light finetune, which is backwards. The most likely explanation is the compatibility screen, not portability. This inference is the matrix's first product and it needs direct testing.

open_cells.about: Deliberately empty. Of roughly 96 technique-architecture pairs, 9 carry published evidence. The emptiness is the finding, and it is what drives testbed construction in Synthcore.

highest_value_untested.why: The naive number is known to be misleading. Nobody has tried to build an SSM-appropriate localisation method and measured whether it recovers.

highest_value_untested.cell: cross_model_monitor under adversarial pressure, any architecture
highest_value_untested.why: The adapter is low-rank and learned, so moving information into its null space is cheaper than fooling the monitor. No paper runs this test. Steps-to-evade for a ported monitor versus a native one is the number that decides deployability.
No cell in this column has published evidence in either number.
